blocks.html: Recorded tracks can be exported, pulled from a TAK Server, and managed from the recordings folder.

slides.title: Export tracks
slides.html: Export a recording's moved-marker tracks as GPX, KML or KMZ to Documents > WinTAK > Export. All marker types are supported except Vehicle Outlines and Vehicle Models. A re-imported track appears on the map, and its marker follows the track during playback.

slides.title: Download events from a TAK Server
slides.html: Create a recording from past server events (within a 24-hour window). Define a map region, choose a Start and End date/time (defaults to a two-hour block ending now), pick the Server if more than one is connected, then Download and OK.

slides.title: Manage recordings & preferences
slides.html: Recordings (.cpr) are stored under AppData > Roaming > WinTAK > Databases > TakReplay; use Open Recordings Folder to view them — you can also drop .cpr files in directly. In Settings / Preferences set Auto Record (record on startup), Pan to Map Events, and the Recordings Directory.
